implementation_summary: F-030: ensurePlanLoaded (plan.ts and the private copy in server.ts used by GET /api/runner/status) sets 'awaiting-review' only when begin() succeeds and still returns the record. A new helper otherRunBusy() gives a 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS body with a plain sentence while session.run.kind is 'audit' or 'benchmark'. approveOnce checks it first. Waiting-plans POST checks it right after reading the body, then takes the slot through begin() with no await after the plan comes off the kept list; if begin() fails the plan goes back on the list and the answer is 409. Generation (one bump from begin), events clear, PLAN_READY broadcast, beta rules and the awaiting-review replacement for 'checkup' are unchanged.

risks: server.ts changed (one condition in private ensurePlanLoaded, used by GET /api/runner/status); the coordinator accepted it.

GET /api/runner/plan answers 404 while an audit or benchmark holds the slot and the Check-up was idle (getPlan's phase gate unchanged). The Plan is kept and shows again once the slot is free; changing getPlan would be needed to show it during the audit.

Waiting-plans now claims the slot before setting the old waiting Plan aside and saving the new one. If those disk writes fail, the slot shows awaiting-review for the new run while the stored current plan can still be the old one. The old code had no error handling here either.
begin() resets the abort and finish controllers on resume; nothing uses them while a Plan awaits review.
New 409 ERR_RUN_IN_PROGRESS answers on POST /api/runner/plan/approve and POST /api/runner/waiting-plans while an audit or benchmark runs; no other API shape change.
